runtime.command_template: python tools/run_pinmame_harness.py --library <libpinmame> --game cftbl_p3 --rom-path <vpinmame-roms> --work-dir <new-isolated-state> --handle-mechanics 0 --scenario tools/harness-scenarios/wpc-fliptronic/cftbl-flasher-test.json --dmd-dir <external-dmd-dir> --output <external-run.json>. Each Up press selects the next flasher; in repeat mode the ROM pulses it until the next press and prints its own name, its number (which equals the public address PinMAME publishes) and the drive and supply wire colours. The test steps fifteen flashers, 02 to 36, and wraps to 02. Solenoids 20 and 24 move throughout because the attract-mode chase-light decoder runs in the background.

raw_runs.nvram_initialization: empty; the run created its own isolated PinMAME state directory, so the ROM performed its own factory reset before the scenario left the message loop with Escape

source.attribution: Generated locally from pinned PinMAME and the user-authorized ROM corpus; ROM bytes remain external. Public switch writes are host stimuli, never ROM observations. The runner can checkpoint only segment-display text, so the DMD service-menu navigation is counted pulses; every diagnostic snapshot's interpreted_text is the curator's visual reading of its retained DMD frame, identified by its pixel SHA-256. The exact external directory manifest (built by tools/build_external_evidence_manifest.py) lists the raw trace, the copied scenario, the DMD frames and the isolated mutable state, with no ROM bytes. Exact external directory manifest p3-cftbl-flasher-test/manifest.json SHA-256 2d6cb50415918c216403ae6f7748c755013f571e94bf139e7bb646b5fd33e952.
